PIT.week9_result: BYE in Week 9. Last game was Week 8 (Nov 1): beat Cleveland 27-6 to move to 6-2 on a four-game win streak. Rodgers was quiet (13/25, 172 yds, 0 TD, 1 INT) and Jaylen Warren carried the offense (143 rush yds, TD). No in-game injuries surfaced in search results.

qb.notes: Rodgers started Week 8 and no injury or practice concern was found in any post-Nov 3 result. Schedule-file projection looks correct. Sacked 23 times through 8 games per a Nov 2026 Steelers-site piece. Season line per ESPN: 1,871 yds, 13 TD, 6 INT.

BAL.week9_result: Lost 33-10 at home to Jacksonville on Thursday Night Football (Nov 5), a fourth straight loss, to fall to 4-5. Undrafted rookie Joe Fagnano started at QB (10/18, 2 INT) and the team had 57 passing yards. S Kyle Hamilton left with a hip injury. The only TD came against Jacksonville backups.

qb.notes: The schedule file's Tyler Huntley is WRONG. Lamar Jackson (right thumb, surgery) and Huntley (turf toe, reportedly season-ending) both went on IR Nov 5. Fagnano started Week 9. Baltimore acquired Brissett from Arizona on Nov 6 and coach Jesse Minter said Nov 9 'I do expect Jacoby Brissett to be our starter Monday night.' Austin Reed was released. Kedon Slovis is also in the QB room. Brissett will have had about 10 days in the system.
